# openbim-ifc-wasm

WebAssembly bindings for openbim-ifc: read, edit and write IFC STEP files from JavaScript.

## Overview

WebAssembly bindings for the IFC facade (ADR 0013, #34).

Reads, edits and writes IFC STEP files from JavaScript. The surface is the
record model: an `IfcModel` holds entities, each a type name plus
positional attributes. Attribute values cross the boundary in the lossless
tagged encoding of `openbim_ifc_binding_core::value`, so a file read and
written back through JavaScript is unchanged.

Every operation lives in `openbim-ifc-binding-core`, shared with the C and
Python bindings. This crate converts JS arguments and results only, and is
empty outside `wasm32`.

A test of anything that does not need a JS host belongs in
`openbim-ifc-binding-core`, where `cargo test` runs it natively; the Node
suites here cover only the JS conversion itself.

## Changes

Latest release, 0.8.0 (2026-10-13):

### Changed (#433, wire format 1.3)

- The geometry graph payload (#367) may be Axiolid's wire format 1.3
  (`axiolid-model` 0.3.12), a minor version of the format (ADR 0021,
  amended): an `IfcOffsetCurveByDistances` along an offset whose length is
  a quadrature now lowers, continued to the basis's ends the kernel
  measures. An envelope carries the lowest version its content needs, so
  every other payload is unchanged: 1.0, 1.1 or 1.2. A reader on
  `axiolid-model` 0.3.11 or older refuses 1.3.
  `GeometryGraphEnvelope.version` documents the rule.

Semver: minor, as ADR 0021 states for a minor version of the wire format.
